The '''Separatist Heavy Speeder''' was a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] experimental [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] developed during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was going to be tested on [[Nothoiin/Legends|Nothoiin]], however, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] managed to [[Liberation of Nothoiin|liberate]] Nothoiin before the Separatists could even unpack it. When the Separatist forces retreated from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], they left the repulsorcraft behind, thus falling in the Republic's hands.
